case_name: Marbly v. Mayor, City Of Southfield, Michigan
text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed
  
   informa pauperis
  
  denied, and certiorari dismissed. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. As petitioner has repeatedly abused this Court’s process, the Clerk is directed not to accept any further petitions in noncriminal matters from petitioner unless the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) is paid and the petition is submitted in compliance with Rule 33.1. See
  
   Martin
  
  v.
  
   District of Columbia Court of Appeals,
  
  506 U. S. 1 (1992)
  
   (per curiam).
  

  Justice Stevens dissents.
 

  See
  
   id.,
  
  at 4, and cases cited therein.
